items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Harry James and Angels Sing - Chris Griffin and ^ what was his name?

ctx.x: Anyhow, this was the first time that we had ever got like they gonna run us out of the Savoy. You know, the Savoy people was with us on account of us being the house band. But, you know, they liked to, they run us out of the Savoy? Bunny Berigan and Buddy Rich and all, they got on there and they sounded like an 18 piece band. They really played. We had a lot of fun. That's when I first met Bunny. And Bunny, he was a real nice guy. I knew him well.

I met Harry James when he was with Goodman. I'm downtown at the Harlem Opera House at 52nd and Broadway. I was there for a year. Well, Harry James with Goodman, Harry James and Angels Sing - Chris Griffin and ^ what was his name?
